<thought>After analyzing the mass spectrum (M⁺ ≈ 224 Da) and the 13C NMR data (one carbonyl carbon at ~197 ppm, multiple aromatic carbons around 128–143 ppm, and aliphatic carbons near 36 ppm), the most consistent structure is the symmetric 1,3‑diphenyl‑1,3‑propanedione (dibenzoylmethane). Its molecular formula C₁₅H₁₂O₂ matches the observed mass, and the NMR pattern fits a central CH₂ flanked by two equivalent carbonyls and two phenyl rings. The SMILES representation for this molecule is:</thought>
<final_answer>O=C(Cc1ccccc1)C(=O)c1ccccc1</final_answer>
